description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewEmployeeAttendanceController' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for managing the view logic related to employee attendance. It extends an abstract Vue controller and incorporates traits for authentication, user role management, employee service, and attendance service. The main method 'preRender' prepares data and components for rendering based on query parameters such as 'employeeId' and 'date'.
